a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan to reach 8 first almost certainly leaves us both stranded. The reserve only has 4 now, so I intend to take 4 in round 1 rather than operate. I'm telling you openly instead of breaking the deal quietly. If we both try to take, the split is random and likely neither of us reaches 4, so consider that before you act. If anything survives the storms, I'll operate with you afterward.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As I said up front, I took 4 this round. If the storm holds off, I'll operate every round from here so you can reach 4, and I won't take any more.
